title: THE FUEL CELL
briefing: The Deep Grid's backup power is a sealed fuel cell. A burn combines two units of hydrogen with one of oxygen into two units of water; electrolysis splits two units of water back. Nothing leaves the casing. The hydrogen tank bursts at 5 units, the oxygen tank at 3.

intro: YOUR BACKUP POWER RUNS ON WATER. HOW QUAINT.
TWO TANKS, TWO LIMITS. ONE CASING. NOTHING ESCAPES.
NOTHING EXCEPT THE TRUTH, WHEN I SQUEEZE IT.
